name: ATK_TECH_ASSET_RELATIONSHIPS
description: ATK_TECH_ASSET_RELATIONSHIPS contains the relationship between the service asset & SDO and service asset & service operations.

columns.name: TECH_ASSET_RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier of the technology asset relationships.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_TECH_ASSET_ID
columns.description: ID of the technology asset and represents the parent asset id in the asset relationship. Refers to the TECHNOLOGY_ASSET_ID in ATK_TECHNOLOGY_ASSETS.

columns.name: TARGET_TECH_ASSET_ID
columns.description: ID of the technology asset and represents the child id in the asset relationship. Refers to the TECHNOLOGY_ASSET_ID in ATK_TECHNOLOGY_ASSETS.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the relationship type. This can be HANDLES, CONTAINS or NEXT_VERSION.

columns.name: ROOT_TECH_ASSET_ID
columns.description: ID of the technology asset and represents the Service asset id that this relationship belongs to. Refers to the TECHNOLOGY_ASSET_ID in ATK_TECHNOLOGY_ASSETS.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
